plan.title: Adipose treated vs control DE with sex/age covariates
plan.analytical_narrative: Twelve adipose bulk RNA-seq samples (6 treated, 6 control), unpaired, single batch, with sex (F/M) and age (years) recorded per sample and the groups not age-matched. Sex and age are known potential confounders of adipose transcriptional state, so both go into the DESeq2 design as fixed-effect covariates alongside condition, rather than being regressed out beforehand (regressing out a covariate and testing residuals borrows the condition signal and produces overconfident p-values in an unbalanced design). Track 1 runs QC, filtering, the covariate-adjusted DESeq2 Wald test with apeglm shrinkage, and BH-adjusted results with independent filtering. Track 2 takes the full ranked list of tested genes (ranked on the Wald statistic) into fgsea preranked GSEA against MSigDB Hallmark, then Reactome, both present in the reference store for human. A final report step consolidates DE results, fit diagnostics, enrichment tables with leading-edge genes, and a full reproducibility record. Given only 12 000 background genes and 6 vs 6 unpaired samples, the design is adequately grounded for the DESeq2 Wald/apeglm path per the knowledge service; robustness is checked by comparing to an edgeR quasi-likelihood fit on the same design.
